title: Case-insensitive commands

blocks.text: `"hello".equals("Hello")` is `false`. `equalsIgnoreCase` compares without regard to case. Calling it on the literal you know, `"quit".equalsIgnoreCase(input)`, is also safe when `input` is `null`: the answer is simply `false`.
Write `isQuit(String input)` in `Commands`. It says whether the user typed the command `quit`, in any case, with any spaces around it:

cases.says: "quit" is the command; "quite" and "" are not.
isQuit(null) is false, not a NullPointerException.

concepts: equalsIgnoreCase compares without regard to case, and calling it on a known literal is null-safe.
